items.title: Compatible systems of perfect complexes and endomorphisms assemble into a limit complex with compatible traces
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file trace.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: 77 行、极限复与迹的拼合：极小自由代表系给一致有界的 K_n^bullet；极限得有限自由 Z_ℓ 复 K_∞^•，上同调为极限；Frobenius 图在导出范畴交换 ⇒ 逐层提升同伦严格化 π_n^•，得 π_∞^•；迹链 t_∞ 与上同调迹经 Q_ℓ 化后相等。承重全在 span 内；1 处引用（定理 C，收尾指认）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-piece-together (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2584-2610

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: represent each K_n by a canonical minimal free complex, glue the isomorphisms into a finite complex of finite free Z_l-modules K_infinity, resolve the homotopy noncommutativity of the Frobenius diagrams by inductively adding homotopies, and compare the traces of the assembled endomorphism with the limit of the traces (source lines 2612-2688)
